subject: af-td
title: AF.TD.------AFI(1)
description: Diagram in AF(D)-21 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's diagnostic that 'the solidification of alternative viewpoints cannot affect the basic lining of western culture — and because of this, positive transformation is negated (or stopped)' under suppressed affinity dynamics. (C)AF-TD (the concept of affinity tendencies) is crossed with AFI(1) (affinity insight—first degree): the question is what affinity-tendencies produce when crossed with first-degree affinity-insight — the (1) marker on AFI being load-bearing, distinguishing it from the second degree, AFI(2), in Braxton's CODE list. SF-RZ (self-realization) drops from the main line and carries (R)TM (the reality of terminology—or terms of a definition) and a long line to SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars). From SOC-RT-P rise VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and PER-TRS (perceived transition), and AFL (affinity alignment) drops; AFL carries IST-F (isolated focus) and ACT-T. ACT-T (actual terms) anchors the lower-right via a *dashed* edge to ALT-F (alternative functionalism). In Braxton's legend a dotted line amplifies some aspect of the main concept it is connected to.
